data.one_liner: Update your GitHub gh-pages branch with compiled Dart web app output.
data.what_it_does: Peanut builds your Dart or Flutter web app and automatically commits the compiled output to your local gh-pages branch. It handles running `flutter build web` or `build_runner` and supports custom build configurations, post-build scripts, and automatic version info injection.
use_when: You want to host a Dart or Flutter web app on GitHub Pages
You want an automated way to build and push web outputs to the gh-pages branch
avoid_when: You are deploying web apps to hosting providers other than GitHub Pages via git branches
strengths: Simplifies GitHub Pages deployment for Dart and Flutter web
Allows running custom post-build Dart scripts before committing
weaknesses: Limited specifically to updating a git branch with web build output
data.setup_notes: Activate globally using `dart pub global activate peanut` or `flutter pub global activate peanut`, then run `peanut` in your project root.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate peanut
peanut
